content.expected_result: Keep terms tied to definitions, intent and source.
preconditions: Create a named typed constant, a related story and a term with aliases and an exact code reference in a disposable source/Saga fixture.

steps.action: Query the term and inspect its reading page and references.
steps.expected_result: Name, definition, aliases, related stories/records and defining code are discoverable.

steps.action: Rename the defining constant, query term health, and edit the current term with deliberately reassessed defining-code references.
steps.expected_result: The changed source pin is stale and names its stable term owner; the explicit edit restores current linkage without changing the independent semantic axes.

content.title: Keep terms tied to definitions, intent and source
